note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 5176 Section 3.4 and HEAD code (packet.go VerifyCoAMessageAuthenticator). radius/rfc5176_message_authenticator_test.go::TestRFC5176MessageAuthenticatorZeroesBothFields and TestRFC5176MessageAuthenticatorRefusesEveryOtherStream directly isolate VerifyCoAMessageAuthenticator with an independent RFC signer, asserting non-zero wire Request Authenticator acceptance and rejecting non-zeroed Request Authenticator, non-zeroed Message-Authenticator (0x77), tampered attributes, wrong secret and zero value. authradius/rfc5176_walk_test.go::TestRFC5176MessageAuthenticatorZeroesBothFields proves conformant acceptance end-to-end over UDP; its negative case reproduces the coupled pre-fix inverted order (which trips VerifyCoARequestAuth before VerifyCoAMessageAuthenticator under conformant RequestAuth, while the radius direct tests isolate VerifyCoAMessageAuthenticator independently).
